title: I want cute plushies !
description: Add some cute plushies to your world !
body:
![Alpha Plushies]
![1.0 plushies](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0425d06d7c5d79455ea8de3475edf3f77f7cd7fc.png)
**_I WANT CUTE PLUSHIES !_**

Who doesn't like plushies ? who !? 

This mod adds plushies to decorate your beautiful world ! These plushies come from Pop culture such as Movies, Animes, Video games or even Viusual Novels ! 

For the moment there are characters from: Vocaloids(and utau, fanloid...) Animes (One punch man, Tonikawa..) and Visual novels ( Steins;Gate..).

I highly recommend playing this mod with Just Enough Item.

To craft Plushies, you will need to obtain a Sewing machine.
![Sewing Machine](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cb07dd0870288eb29fb95fc612cbfc780562733a.png)
![Sewing Machine Interface](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/83a6ab969924209a31eff1253a779fce70cc78d8.png)![Sewing Machine recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fd01dc9d7ae9ec95a1b677b6819d7daac4949a87.png)

The plushies are made with wool and thread bobbins as you can see !

The "?" indicates special items, such as a leek for Hatsune Miku or a Clock for Okabe Rintarou.

![Miku recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a734f745e4231725f48483e065f8a2c6f703bcd4.png)![okabe recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/60b640bd42029f2b19e6923dbadc2753e6f1d1b3.png)

You can interact with every plushies, it can be noises or other.

The mod add a lot of Achievement and Easter eggs !
![achievements](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d31f1258a821cb2f8b7112209b1a1756960625f7.png)

None of the characters in this mod are made by me, all rights goes to 07th Expansion, Dreamworks, Shueisha, Kadokawa etc..
